# Foundation Dataset — Manifest

- Examples (experiments): **18570**
- Distinct instances: 23
- Operator vocabulary: 14
- Rows with timing/trajectory metadata: 18570

Each row is `structural features → algorithm (operator sequence + budgets + temperatures) → outcome (score, improvement, work)`. This is the corpus a Research Foundation Model would train on.

## Distance to foundation scale (honest)

A foundation model that predicts algorithm behavior across problem families needs orders of magnitude more data than this. Progress toward the milestones:

| milestone | examples | reached? | multiplier still needed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 500000 | 18570 | no | 27× |
| 1000000 | 18570 | no | 54× |
| 5000000 | 18570 | no | 269× |
| 20000000 | 18570 | no | 1077× |

**Verdict:** with 18570 examples, this is a training corpus, not a foundation model. Building a Transformer / Graph-Transformer / GNN on it now would over-fit; the honest path is to GROW this dataset (Curiosity Engine for informative data, Scientific Memory to never lose it) until the milestones are met — only then does a large model have something to learn.
